_readme: Calibrated on SYNTHETIC (text-to-speech) identities only. Thresholds MUST be re-measured with real consenting speakers before any real use. See docs/VOICE_EVALUATION.md.

dataset.note: calibration and held-out identities are disjoint; siblings (same-name UK/US voices) are the same underlying voice

decision.note: score = max cosine over the profile references; a cluster is matched only if it is the ONLY one reaching tMatch
decision.evidenceRule: Doctor decisions need >= 3 regions and >= 6 s per speaker: with 1 region 55% of genuine doctor clusters scored below the reject line (wrongly 'unknown'), 3.9% with 3 regions. Non-doctors were never matched (0 of 4560 clusters) at any amount of evidence.

clustering.evidenceRule: Measured: the correct-split rate was ~96% whether the smaller voice had 1 or 4 regions, and the false-split rate did not fall with more regions, so more evidence buys no measured safety. A floor of one region of at least 2.5 s remains so a cough or a laugh alone cannot become a speaker. Real-world artefacts (crosstalk, background TV) are NOT measured.
clustering.thresholdRule: Upper part of the calibrated plateau (0.375-0.575; the centre, 0.475, was the first choice). Independent clustering only runs when Deepgram found ONE speaker, so a split that is too eager fabricates speakers while one that is too cautious just leaves Deepgram's answer: the costs are asymmetric. On real recordings 0.475 over-split one recording (a variable, hoarse voice became 4 speakers) and 0.55 did not, at equal recall (35/36 correct counts on 36 fixtures and pair recordings).

enrollment.sampleConsistencyRule: highest different-person sample-set similarity in the calibration voices (0.455) + 0.10, deliberately looser than the midpoint (0.679) because real speech varies more between recordings than synthetic speech
enrollment.minVoicedSecondsRule: 75% of the shortest genuine synthetic sample (7.6 s detected speech, median 9.1 s): allows the natural pauses of a 10 s recording. An earlier 8 s minimum sat above the shortest genuine sample and wrongly rejected honest enrollments.
